_meta.name: Tamkinly brand.json — machine-readable source of truth v1.0
_meta.usage: Source for automated brand gates (step 5): colors, typography, tagline, spelling, message layers.

identity.coining_reason: The previous name was lost/confused within the industry that preceded it — coined fresh 2026-11-08 by the founder.

tagline.rule: Layer 1 — fixed in every live page title (EN + AR).

why_sentence.en: Consciously build the person you choose to become.
why_sentence.ar: ابنِ بوعيٍ كامل الشخص الذي تختار أن تصبحه.
why_sentence.rule: Layer 2 — About page + founder posts. Complementary, never a replacement for the tagline.

framework.model: WHY -> HOW -> WHAT (brand philosophy for marketing)

terracotta_soft.role: warm touch ONLY — explicitly NOT a warning color (founder decision 2026-11-08)

semantic.rule: Distinct from warm accents. Values as implemented in globals.css (commit 93c4da6).

dark_mode.application: deferred to a standalone release after a full review — especially TRC therapy pages (founder decision 2026-11-08)

arabic_sans.status: official Arabic brand font — approved by founder 2026-11-08

typography.base_note: 18px root = founder-approved therapeutic reading scale (scales the whole rem-based system).
typography.tech_note: var(--font-arabic) is referenced in globals.css but not yet loaded — load IBM Plex Sans Arabic in the next typography pass.

products_family.scope: Full family — never describe the brand as only 3 protocol pages.

accounts_source.rule: Every @handle used in published content MUST exist there. Banned: @tamkinlyhq.
